findings.title: Merging toggles-fixes conflicts in the default picks' bake and its check, and the facts rehearsal's step 7 was made with this branch's bake
findings.where: reader/tools/bake-default-picks-v1.mjs and reader/tools/check-default-picks-v1.mjs (ledgers-build 27feeb2ea2 against toggles-fixes 05f65ef014 in S/pt); S/v64/steps/ship4-facts-steps.sh step 7 (lines 127-136) and S/v64/steps/ship4-facts-sha256.txt

findings.title: The made spaces' second road picks its rounds by the versions reached since, and does not refuse a row strike the record lacks
findings.evidence: This confirms the builder's (c), with a demonstration. `since = new Set(history.slice(at + 1).map((h) => h.now))` keeps a round of the record whenever its 'now' version is in that set. That is the version-reached test the follower's header says is never asked, and it never refuses a history move by a row-strike rule that the record does not hold. I made a wrong state whose history holds one such move. apply-made-spaces --dry went on ('counts_held: the second road', 0 rows move). apply-row-entries --dry and check-entry-gate E3, E4 and E5 refused the same state ('the store's history holds 1 row strike(s) since 90d9eb8e7082 that the row-strikes record does not hold'). Today secondRoad and roundsSince() pick the same two rounds (call 5 and v188); I checked this with both modules.

findings.title: The follower refuses a struck name that a later round reuses, but not a moved name
findings.where: reader/tools/row-strikes-follow-v1.mjs:192-197 (walkOn); bake-default-picks-v1.mjs:404-414 and check-default-picks resolveRows (they find a row as named before asking)
findings.evidence: Probe on a made-up record. If a name is struck and a later round lands a row under the same name, nowOf refuses: 'a name cannot say which of the two a list means'. If the name is re-keyed instead and a later round lands a row under the old name, nowOf answers 're-keyed' to the new key, while thenOf says the row under the old name 'landed after'. One name then means two rows and nothing refuses. The default picks' bake and check D2 match a row as named first, so they would take the newly landed row, while apply-row-entries would follow the moved one. Today's record has no such case: 0 names that call 5 took were landed again by v188.
findings.suggested_fix: In walkOn's re-keyed branch, refuse when a round from i on puts a row under the old name, as the struck/withheld branch already does at :193-194.

findings.title: Both steps scripts say 'Nothing of this step was written' even when they stop after a real write
findings.where: S/v64/steps/ship4-store-steps.sh:95 (stop), reached after writes at :150-152 (call 5 already landed at :148), :163 (the derived lists already written at :161) and :118; S/v64/steps/ship4-facts-steps.sh:85, reached after writes at :107 (dry run again after the real run), :135 (after the bake wrote 41 files) and :159
findings.evidence: stop() always prints that nothing of the step was written. Several of its callers run after the step's tool has already written to reader/data. A lead who sees this message after a failed figure would take a half-written tree for an untouched one.
findings.reproduce: Read the lines named above. For example, if the re-key map's dry figures differ at store step 1, the script stops with 'STOPPED at step 1 ... Nothing of this step was written', but call 5 has already landed.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass stop() whether the step has already written, and name the tool that wrote and the files the snapshot shows changed.

(c) A silent mis-merge with no marker: the main loop takes toggles-fixes' `rowText[i] = routePrinted(found[0])`, but this branch's follower block keeps `rowText[i] = found[0][1]`.

build.summary:
Ship 4's facts side is finished and proven. I wrote no code: nothing authored was missing, and the tree has no new commit. The twin mend was already in place, in commit 0378a53493 (the follower's twinKeyOf plus apply-row-entries). Tree /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-mashiachsonyosef-github-io/c72302ec-11e7-5b6d-a5ab-47bb077585fe/scratchpad/b4, branch ledgers-build, HEAD 27feeb2ea2, holds the 3 store commits and the 8 facts commits. Its reader/data is the after-3 state plus facts steps 6 to 8: store ccec4fa3071b, 651,752 routes, 122,496 keys, 310 modified and 2 untracked generated paths, all uncommitted, nothing staged.

1. REVIEW
- Before I ran anything the tree was at after-3: store 5bee25fd9681, 651,752 routes, 122,496 keys, and all 269 generated paths match state/after3/SHA256.txt. The builder had re-made it at 09:28 to 09:30 by running the store steps through 3 at HEAD, and that table equals the proven one.
- state.sh can no longer load anything. The saved files of state/after3 and state/after5 were deleted at about 09:26; only MANIFEST.txt and SHA256.txt are left. `state.sh load` would first reset every generated path to the commit and then fail on the copy. Do not use it. In its place I saved the after-3 bytes of the 46 paths the facts steps write in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-mashiachsonyosef-github-io/c72302ec-11e7-5b6d-a5ab-47bb077585fe/scratchpad/v64/ship4-facts/mine/after3-facts-paths.
- Calls 6 and 2 are held as the lead decided. data/audit-calls/PIN.json gives each landing a `held` entry with its reason. A6 and A7 are green. The strike record has no call-6 or call-2 round, and no tool reads call6-picks-words-withheld-too.
- Twin mend, checked by an independent recount from call 5's own list and the ledger (scripts/recount-twins.py). There are 4,109 SAME_SOURCE_TWIN lines; 4,061 are of the ledger's 15 sources, and every one has its twin in the ledger. Call 5's repoint_picks_to agrees with the twin found by source and words in every case. Exactly 2 pairs have a twin that lacks an entry: M5 rank 1 «from» gives n H4480 and b m.cl.aa to rank 12, and M5 rank 20 «out of» gives the same to rank 41. Both pairs are recorded in data/row-entries-receipt-v1.json and index.row_entries.followed.entries_given_to_a_twin, with the two rows named.
- The builder also gives BDB's own entry (b), not only the number. That is right: with n alone, the twin would carry the numbers of two entries but BDB's entry of only one. It changes no other verdict, because no BDB (M5) row under the key lacks a number.
- Lint: the 11 changed tools are clean at the base and at HEAD, and a probe file shows the linter reads the folder. No Hebrew characters in the tools, and no British spellings in the added lines.

2. PROOF OF THE MEND
- The 600 call-5 lines of entry-gate-after-call5-v1.2.jsonl, measured with the page's own gate functions at each place's core tags:
  - after-3: 0 let through, 600 withheld;
  - final state: 468 let through (all «from»), 132 still withheld.
- All 132 still withheld are OTHER_SOURCE_TWIN on call 5's list.
